==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There are three worlds. One for fairies, one for humans, and one for aliens. There is a nexus of worlds where each is accessible via a portal. The nexus is located at a magical academy that bridges these three worlds.

I go on a mission with a group of living toys each possessed by fairies. I ask one of the toys to help with a task over a lava pit. The toy sadly falls and dies in the lava.

I go to the sewers to visit my fallen comrade's sister and tell them what happened. The sister smiles but dies of grief. Her shadow fires an attack at me that ultimately kills me.

I see green glittering light, almost like a glowing green mist. I feel as if I am awake, but I can't explain the presence of this light that feels alive. When I open my eyes, the light vanishes.
